REPAIR RECIPE FILES IN YOUR BROWSER

Fix broken recipe imports before saving

For people who run their own recipe app and need to fix a file before importing it.

Try it with sample data
Choose your file

The sample opens with three repairable issues.

⌂
Files stay in this browser
↯
Works offline after first visit
$0
Free — no account needed
Inspect recipe fields. Review each repair. Preserve source attribution.

RECIPE FILE PREVIEW

Inspect a recipe file

Paste JSON, JSON-LD, or Markdown. You see the parsed fields before you export anything.

NO FILE READ
Clear recipe and results

INPUT

Recipe source
Choose file
Paste JSON, JSON-LD, or Markdown

Maximum file size: 2 MB. Source URLs are preserved and never opened.

Inspect recipe

INSPECTION

Parsed recipe
↳
Your parsed fields will appear here

Paste recipe text or choose a file. Then inspect it.

HOW RECIPE REPAIR WORKS

Repair a recipe in three steps
01
Read the file

The tool separates title, source, ingredients, and steps.

02
Review each repair

Every suggested repair shows its exact before and after value.

03
Choose an export format

Download Recipe JSON-LD or keep the source file format.

PRIVACY AND LIMITS

What stays in your browser

The tool does not fetch recipe pages. Repairs do not change cooking instructions.

No recipe text leaves your device. No account is required.

session.demo:recipe-import-repair:source:
{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "Recipe",
  "name": "Rosemary tomato beans",
  "description": "A weeknight pantry supper from a handwritten family card.",
  "author": "Mara Vale",
  "url": "https://example.com/mara/rosemary-tomato-beans",
  "recipeYield": "4 bowls",
  "prepTime": "PT10M",
  "cookTime": "PT25M",
  "recipeIngredient": [
    "1½ cups cooked white beans",
    "2..5 tablespoons olive oil",
    "2 cloves garlic, sliced",
    "3 teaspoons tomato paste",
    "1 tbsp chopped rosemary",
    "400 g canned tomatoes"
  ],
  "recipeInstructions": [
    {"@type": "HowToStep", "text": "Warm the oil and garlic over medium heat."},
    {"@type": "HowToStep", "text": "Add rosemary, beans, and tomatoes. Simmer for 20 minutes."},
    {"@type": "HowToStep", "text": "Taste, season, and serve."}
  ]
}
